title: POST /tournaments/:id/rounds/:n/lineups/confirm request
description: Confirm every line-up of the round that is not confirmed yet, both sides of each match: the Pairings page's 'Confirm all line-ups for this round'. No body is needed, and nothing left to confirm is not a refusal. Answered with round-response.schema.json (200). Refusals (error.schema.json): 404 not_paired, 409 not_team_event, 409 archived / handed_off; 403 arbiter_role and 404 as for any desk route.
